name: Project 3: Course Scheduler
description: Implement a course scheduler that detects prerequisite cycles using depth-first search on a directed graph, then produces a valid topological ordering. Analyze the time complexity of your solution and justify your choice of adjacency list representation.

rubric.criterion: Correct cycle detection on directed graphs

name: Lab 5: Fault-Tolerant Key-Value Store
description: Design and implement a replicated key-value store with a leader and two followers. Handle node failure with heartbeat-based failure detection and leader election. Expose the store through a REST API and document the consistency guarantees your design provides.

rubric.criterion: Replication and leader election work under node failure

name: Assignment 2: CI Pipeline and Test Automation
description: Set up a continuous integration pipeline that builds a Dockerized service, runs unit and integration tests on every push, and reports coverage. Write a short report on defects the pipeline caught.
